answer: By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the zephyr until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the grove of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
